name: Analytic Derivative of Tri-linear Interpolation
definition: A method to compute the partial derivatives of a tri-linearly interpolated grid function (such as color \(\vec{c}\) or density \(\sigma\)) with respect to the sample location \(p_i = (x_i, y_i, z_i)\), used for gradient-based optimization in neural implicit representations.
summary: Analytic Derivative of Tri-linear Interpolation computes exact partial derivatives of grid functions by solving a linear system for polynomial coefficients, providing precise gradients for optimization unlike numerical approximations.
